source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The virtual-folder selection dialog uses min-width: 27em and min-height: 25em, and the log dialogs use 40em by 25em. They retain persisted window position and size. The historical fixes remove fixed tree height or window width/height attributes in favor of CSS minimums. Current HTML dialog markup retains the minimum constraints. Check both the outer document and dialog when porting adjacent dialogs; this is not a fixed size for every window.
title: Use CSS minimum dimensions for these persisted dialogs
